01 / WHAT WE DO

Moving goods.
Handling the details.

Flexible transport for part and full loads, with loading and unloading support for every stage of your shipment.

↗

Product transportation

Body, full-body and half-body trucks in 25-, 30-, 35- and 40-ton capacities, with GPS-equipped trucks for shipment monitoring.

↑

Loading

Loading services to get your products ready for their journey.

↓

Unloading

Unloading services at the destination to complete the movement of your goods.

OUR VEHICLES

The right vehicle.
For your load.

Our company profile describes a network of more than 150 vehicles. Options include body trucks and 40 ft open trailers, with flat-bed, semi-bed and low-bed configurations. Trailer capacities include 23, 28, 32 and 40 tons.

02 / WHAT WE CARRY

A range of goods.
A clear purpose.

Explore the materials we transport below. We also carry blooms, scrap, rods, round bars, coke, met coke, slag, carbon bricks, powder bags, rice, dal, wheat, groundnut, paddy, fertilizer and mango boxes.

Connecting your business
across India.
